card.name: Ending of drug-class phrases in warnings
card.fires_on: The last word of a drug-class or patient-group phrase in warning text, such as antidepress<<ants>>, opioid<< use>>, corticoster<<oids>> or opportunistic<< infections>>. It sits just before a clause that continues the warning.

modes.label: Drug class endings
modes.description: The closing piece of a drug-class name in an interaction or effect warning.
modes.example: including triptans, tricyclic antidepress<<ants>>, fentanyl, lithium, tramadol

modes.label: Word after opioid
modes.description: The noun 'use' following 'opioid' in adrenal insufficiency warnings.
modes.example: Cases of adrenal insufficiency have been reported with opioid<< use>>, more often following greater than one month

modes.label: Condition or group noun
modes.description: A noun that ends a modifier phrase, such as infections or patients.
modes.example: inflammatory response to indolent or residual opportunistic<< infections>> ( 5.7 ) 5

card.plain: It marks the end of a drug-class or patient-group phrase in a warnings section, right before the sentence moves on.
